description: Source code for F1AP DU connection handler, managing F1-C TNL associations, message forwarding, and connection lifecycle in a 3GPP-compliant network component.

classes.name: f1c_rx_channel
classes.description: Adapter class to handle incoming F1AP messages from the F1-C GW and notify the message handler.

classes.name: f1c_tx_channel
classes.description: Adapter class to send F1AP messages to the F1-C GW and manage the lifetime of the TNL connection.

classes.name: f1ap_du_connection_handler
classes.description: Main class managing F1-C TNL connection, message forwarding, and connection lifecycle events.

methods.name: connect_to_cu_cp
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the CU-CP, sets up message notifiers, and returns a notifier object.

methods.name: handle_connection_loss
methods.description: Handles disconnection events, dispatching cleanup to the appropriate thread.

methods.name: handle_connection_loss_impl
methods.description: Performs the actual cleanup of connection state and signals disconnection to other components.

methods.name: handle_tnl_association_removal
methods.description: Asynchronously handles removal of the TNL association, ensuring proper shutdown sequence.
